messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "taken as a single dose or split into two doses"
set: ["taken as a single dose or split into two doses", "taken as one dose or split into two", "taken as one dose or split into two for high blood pressure", "100 mg a day, split into two doses", "50 mg a day, split into smaller doses", "50 to 100 mg a day, split into smaller doses", "given as two 100 mg doses", "taken as one dose once a day", "one or two months into treatment", "10 mg single dose", "150 mg single dose", "daily dose divided into three equal doses", "daily dosage may be divided into two doses per day", "taken in divided doses", "do not take two doses to make up for a missed dose", "taken once or twice a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
